maintenance_led.reason: Mostly sells new radiation detection instruments, systems and software to nuclear and medical customers; dosimetry services and servicing are a smaller part.

publicly_funded.reason: Customers are mainly nuclear utilities, hospitals, labs and industrial firms; defense and government are a minority of buyers.

serial_acquirer.reason: Grows mainly by selling its detection and measurement products, with occasional acquisitions such as Sun Nuclear, Certrec and Paragon.

mission_critical.reason: Radiation monitoring systems and detectors are qualified into nuclear plants and clinical workflows; switching needs requalification and regulatory approval.

notes: Mirion has made several acquisitions, so the serial-acquirer answer is a judgment call. Aftermarket and service revenue share is not stated in the text.
